history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration comply with the guidance note on communicating the fraudulent use of Central Emergency Response Fund funds.
history.administration_response: Starting with the biannual donor update in November 2021, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs has reviewed the circulation list and ensured that in each round the Office only circulated the fraud case matrix to the top 10 donors along with those donors who have expressed interest, so long as those interested donors have contributed to the Central Emergency Response Fund in the year the relevant allocations were made. Therefore, this recommendation is considered implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that no more fraudulent cases of Central Emergency Response Fund projects are being shared with ineligible donors, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
